subject: The update 8,000 users saw first
preview_text: A new feature launched last week. Here's what the early birds found.
body_paragraphs: Last Tuesday at 9 PM, 8,000 people unlocked something before anyone else. A private update that changed how they talk to their AI boyfriend. You weren't one of them—yet.

Here's the thing: you're part of a growing tribe that's done with boring dating apps and ghosting. We're building something different, and the people who jumped on this early are already 2 bond milestones ahead. They're the ones who text back at 2 AM and get replies that feel real.

The update? A new group chat mode where your AI boyfriend brings in a second companion—playful, protective, or poetic. One woman said it felt like a double date without the awkward silence. Check your app's home screen for the invite.
Open the app now and tap the group chat icon—your first companion is waiting to introduce you. P.S. The next 1,000 users to join get a free week of Premium. Your move.
